issue.title: tool list last is nondeterministic for same-second runs; needs monotonic tie-break in sase-core

task_type_fields.impact: Same-second cohort runs make last nondeterministic; the smoke harness needs a sleep workaround until ordering is monotonic.
task_type_fields.location: sase-core tool list last ordering (whole-second created_ts, random run_id tie-break)
task_type_fields.repro: Create several runs within one wall-clock second, then run tool list -j: the last entry for a tool varies run to run. tools/_smoke_tool_runs_cases_evidence.py typical_cohorts works around it with time.sleep(1.1).

issue.creation_reason: Found during green_master_ci_repair: the dod-6-typical harness case flaked because tool list last orders by whole-second created_ts with random run_id tie-break.
